overrides.replacement_claim: The new public performance CLI lacks compatibility tests covering stable JSON and text output, stdout/stderr separation, and semantic outcome-to-exit-code mappings.
overrides.reason: Both theories describe the same public CLI compatibility-coverage gap. The focused tests cover argument rejection, DTO filtering, and fixture-name presence, while the current conformance review records absent output and exit compatibility coverage.

The supplied production serve path validates performance settings and returns a configuration error before constructing the shared runner. The investigator reports equivalent fail-fast validation in the TUI path, so the alleged production bypass is not established.

overrides.replacement_claim: Performance CLI output failures are silently discarded because JSON encoding and text rendering write errors are ignored.
overrides.reason: The command explicitly discards JSON encoding and formatted-write errors. Retained executable tests using a failing stdout writer observed nil or operation-only returned errors in JSON and text modes.

The CLI status renderer is narrower than browser and TUI presentations, but it still exposes phase, freshness, outcome, targets, and next action. The governed requirement permits presentation-only differences and does not require every surface to render every DTO field, so omission alone does not prove factual disagreement or ambiguity.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance evidence API fails when its advertised URL omits the limit parameter because zero reaches pagination and is rejected.
overrides.reason: A retained HTTP test observed the omitted request reaching PerformanceEvidence with Limit=0 and returning HTTP 500, while an otherwise equivalent direct invocation with Limit=1 succeeded.

Validation rejects configurable values above built-in defaults, exactly matching the documentation's explicit lower-only rule. The separately listed hard maxima are product ceilings, not stated workspace or environment ranges.

overrides.replacement_claim: Persisted repair reverification validation accepts a passing performance record with no target results.
overrides.reason: The validator requires authority identifiers and cleanup for passing outcomes but does not require target results. A retained executable test demonstrated that a passing record with zero TargetResults is accepted.

overrides.replacement_claim: Repair performance reverification associates baselines by slice position rather than target identity, allowing one target to use another target's baseline.
overrides.reason: The repair path checks only slice length and reads baseline[index]. A retained two-target test reordered digest-valid baseline entries and observed each target receiving the other target's median.

overrides.replacement_claim: A met report-only performance target produces a flow summary rejected as invalid because outcome counts are bounded by required-target count only.
overrides.reason: A retained package-local test produced Required=0, Reports=1, Met=1 and observed validatePerformanceFlowSummary reject the summary as invalid performance counts.

overrides.replacement_claim: Optimization rejection paths ignore isolation cleanup failures and can continue to later work without preserving cleanup uncertainty.
overrides.reason: The implementation contains ignored isolation.cleanup results, including cleanup immediately followed by continue. This violates the explicit requirement to stop mutating work when cleanup cannot be proved. Supplied investigator tests did not behaviorally exercise the frozen optimization path, so promotion evidence remains incomplete.

overrides.replacement_claim: Failed candidate or regression measurements omit already executed commands from durable counters, permitting later cycle admission against an understated command total.
overrides.reason: Measurement counters are incremented only after successful MeasurePerformanceTarget calls, while error branches can continue before charging commands. Later admission uses the understated state counter. Executable promotion evidence is not supplied.

overrides.replacement_claim: The JSON performance output parser accepts malformed trailing bytes after a valid envelope.
overrides.reason: The parser rejects a second value only when the second Decode returns nil and ignores syntax errors. A retained parser test observed value 4.2 returned without error for a valid envelope followed by a malformed opening brace.

The documentation explicitly says workspace and environment values may only lower built-in defaults. A separate hard-maximum column does not claim those values are configurable; it records immutable product ceilings required by the governed performance contract. The validator therefore does not contradict the documented configurable range.

overrides.replacement_claim: The project performance-policy parser accepts case-variant mode values despite the exact lowercase contract.
overrides.reason: The parser lowercases Mode before validation. A retained parser test observed ENABLED, Enabled, DISABLED, and Disabled accepted without findings while lowercase controls also passed.

issues.claim: The new public performance CLI lacks compatibility tests covering stable JSON and text output, stdout/stderr separation, and semantic outcome-to-exit-code mappings.
issues.title: Performance CLI compatibility coverage is incomplete
issues.reason: The public CLI contract changed, but supplied tests do not cover its complete stable presentation and exit behavior.

issues.claim: Persisted repair reverification validation accepts a passing performance record with no target results.
issues.title: Passing repair performance records need no target coverage
issues.reason: A persisted pass can satisfy validation without proving that any frozen target was reverified.

issues.claim: The JSON performance output parser accepts malformed trailing bytes after a valid envelope.
issues.title: Performance JSON parser accepts malformed suffixes
issues.reason: A syntax error from the trailing decode is treated as acceptable rather than requiring EOF.

issues.claim: Failed candidate or regression measurements omit already executed commands from durable counters, permitting later cycle admission against an understated command total.
issues.title: Failed measurements evade the command budget
issues.reason: Actual subprocess executions before a measurement error are not charged before the loop decides whether another optimization cycle fits.

issues.claim: Optimization rejection paths ignore isolation cleanup failures and can continue to later work without preserving cleanup uncertainty.
issues.title: Optimization continues after uncertain isolation cleanup
issues.reason: Ignored cleanup failures can permit subsequent expensive or mutating work despite an unproved disposable-workspace cleanup boundary.

issues.claim: Repair performance reverification associates baselines by slice position rather than target identity, allowing one target to use another target's baseline.
issues.title: Repair reverification can use the wrong target baseline
issues.reason: Reordered baseline records remain digest-valid but alter comparisons because identity is not checked before indexed access.

issues.claim: Performance CLI output failures are silently discarded because JSON encoding and text rendering write errors are ignored.
issues.title: Performance CLI drops stdout failures
issues.reason: A failed output write can leave the command reporting success or only its underlying operation error, losing a boundary failure.

issues.claim: A met report-only performance target produces a flow summary rejected as invalid because outcome counts are bounded by required-target count only.
issues.title: Report-only outcomes make flow state invalid
issues.reason: Summary construction counts report outcomes, but validation permits outcome counts only up to the number of required targets.

issues.claim: The project performance-policy parser accepts case-variant mode values despite the exact lowercase contract.
issues.title: Performance policy mode parsing is not exact
issues.reason: Lowercasing before validation turns malformed case variants into valid activation values.

issues.claim: The performance evidence API fails when its advertised URL omits the limit parameter because zero reaches pagination and is rejected.
issues.title: Default performance evidence URL returns an error
issues.reason: Generated links omit limit, the handler forwards zero, and the store rejects zero instead of applying a bounded default.

evidence_requests.gap: The coverage absence is statically supported, but promotion readiness lacks executable compatibility assertions from this origin shard.
evidence_requests.requested_evidence: Create or strengthen an executable Go _test.go compatibility reproducer in the approved private workspace for the performance CLI.
evidence_requests.required_observation: Assert the exact theories covered by exercising representative performance commands and checking stable JSON envelope fields, text output, stdout/stderr separation, and success, target-miss, cancellation, partial, and operational-failure exit mappings. The test supports promotion readiness and must not be presented as proof that coverage was previously absent.
evidence_requests.control_requirement: Include healthy success controls and at least one non-performance command compatibility control using only existing command seams and deterministic fixtures.

evidence_requests.gap: The claim has static evidence but no executable observation of actual runner calls, persisted counters, and subsequent cycle admission.
evidence_requests.requested_evidence: Create a package-local executable Go _test.go reproducer in the approved private workspace using the existing process-runner and runtime seams.
evidence_requests.required_observation: For qa-v1-theory-53f10905cf5035b40ecbb1e8, make candidate or regression measurement fail after one or more runner calls, record actual invocations and durable command counters, and assert whether a later cycle starts such that actual cumulative commands exceed the configured limit.
evidence_requests.control_requirement: Use deterministic outputs and an otherwise identical successful-measurement control whose actual calls equal persisted accounting; do not modify source or assume a new collaborator hook.

evidence_requests.gap: Existing investigator tests inspect source text or simulate an unrelated local loop; neither executes optimizePerformance or observes its state classification.
evidence_requests.requested_evidence: Create a package-local executable Go _test.go reproducer in the approved private workspace using only existing Service hooks, process-runner seams, runtime seams, and isolation behavior.
evidence_requests.required_observation: For qa-v1-theory-35a6a9cbcf6592fb04bb7828, induce a real optimization rejection followed by an isolation cleanup failure, then assert whether any later proposal, profile, correctness, measurement, or mutation call starts and whether returned or persisted state is cleanup_uncertain.
evidence_requests.control_requirement: Include an otherwise identical successful-cleanup control that may continue according to the frozen workflow; do not assume a new cleanup injection hook or source change.

evidence_requests.gap: The retained test checked only a healthy dry-run envelope while its failure marker was triggered by the separate stdout-write defect; it did not execute the claimed exit mappings or stdout/stderr contract.
evidence_requests.requested_evidence: Create or strengthen an executable Go _test.go compatibility reproducer in the approved private workspace for this theory alone.
evidence_requests.required_observation: Assert stable JSON and text output, empty or appropriate stderr, and semantic exit mappings for success, target_missed, cancelled, partial, and operational failure. Name qa-v1-theory-44d9a1998804c860f04368c4 in the assertions.
evidence_requests.control_requirement: Use existing deterministic command/service seams and fixtures; include a passing status or dry-run control and do not rely on a matching marker alone.
